issues: 工作台按 105f 截断，正好切在摘罩那一帧，“沸腾 → 回到真静止”的对比后半段没了
画面左上打着调试标题 "LINE BOIL"，右下是 3px 粗描边的 "boil on/off" 胶囊，像调试界面
被沸腾的描边卡里是实心灰条，沸腾起来读作模糊而不是重描
平铺浅灰底、Helvetica 大字，和卡片 md 说的“纸墨手工感”宿主不沾边
changes: 补 LINE_BOIL_DURATION = 140，完整呈现 静止 35f → 沸腾 70f → 摘罩真静止 35f 三段
宿主改为纸墨字卡：暖纸径向渐变 + 静态大尺度纸纤维（multiply）+ 暖褐暗角；眉题 "CHAPTER TWO"（不入滤镜，当静止参照物），大标题 "Still alive." 用系统 SF 栈 190px/800 负字距，墨色 #1e1d1b
描边卡改为全墨线的手绘分镜卡：不规则起笔外框、三行手写线稿、取景框加人物线、指向箭头和一圈朱红圈注，正好是 md 说的最适合沸腾的对象
调试胶囊换成右下角极小的等宽状态标（朱红实点 boiling / 空心点 still），5f 交叉淡变，100–105f 前全部完成；沸腾参数（scale 8、baseFrequency 0.015、seed=floor(f/3)、条件挂载）不变
issuesEn: The workbench cut it at 105f, exactly on the unmount frame, so the back half of the boil-then-truly-still contrast was missing
A debug title "LINE BOIL" sat top-left and a thick-bordered "boil on/off" pill bottom-right, like a debug panel
The stroked card contained solid grey bars, which read as blur rather than redrawn lines when boiling
Flat light grey and Helvetica display type had nothing to do with the paper-and-ink host the card's md describes
changesEn: Added LINE_BOIL_DURATION = 140 so all three phases play: 35f still, 70f boil, 35f truly still after unmounting

The host is now a paper-and-ink title card: warm radial paper gradient, static large-scale paper fibre (multiply), warm-brown vignette; a "CHAPTER TWO" eyebrow stays outside the filter as a still reference, and the headline "Still alive." is set in the system SF stack at 190px/800 with negative tracking in #1e1d1b ink

The stroked card is now an all-ink-line storyboard sketch: an irregular hand-started frame, three handwritten lines, a viewfinder with a figure, a pointer arrow and a vermilion circle annotation, exactly the kind of subject the md says boils best

The debug pills became a tiny mono state tag bottom-right (solid vermilion dot = boiling, hollow dot = still) with a 5f cross-fade, all finished before 100–105f; boil parameters (scale 8, baseFrequency 0.015, seed = floor(f/3), conditional mounting) unchanged
